## Common questions {#faq}

::: {.faq-list}

<details>
<summary>How long does PEN take?</summary>

Plan on about two hours of video across Modules 1–3: Module 1 is about 57
minutes, Module 2 about 51, and Module 3 about 14. Add time to pause, take
notes, and try the ADA-PARC site yourself. It is self-paced: you can stop after
any unit and pick up where you left off.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Do I have to do the modules in order?</summary>

No, nothing is locked. We suggest going from Module 1 to Module 3, because
each one builds on the one before it. Module 4 is a Resources page you can
use any time.

</details>

<details>
<summary>How do I change the colors or text size?</summary>

Use the **Display** button at the bottom left of any page. You can choose a
dark or high contrast theme, larger text, an easy-to-read font, more space
between lines, underlined links, and less motion. Your choices are saved only
in this browser, like your progress. **Reset to defaults** puts everything back.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Where is my progress saved?</summary>

Only in the browser you are using right now. There is no account and
nothing is sent to us. That means:

- Your progress **will not follow you** to another device or browser.
- **Clearing your browser data**, or using a private window, erases it.

If you switch devices, you can mark the units you already finished as
complete again.

</details>

<details>
<summary>How do I get my certificate?</summary>

Mark every unit in Modules 1–3 complete, and your
[certificate](certificate.qmd) unlocks. Type your name, then print it or save
it as a PDF.

Because your progress lives only in this browser, **save the PDF as soon as it
unlocks**.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Is there a test or quiz?</summary>

No. You will get a separate goal-setting worksheet to fill out and send back by
email. See [How to use PEN](how-to-use.qmd).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Can I use PEN with a screen reader or keyboard only?</summary>

Yes. The site is built to work with both. Read the
[accessibility statement](accessibility.qmd) for details, and tell us if
anything gets in your way.

</details>

:::

## Something not working? {#report}

::: {.pen-note}
If a page, video, or control does not work for you, we treat it as a bug.
Tell us which page, what you were using (browser, screen reader, or keyboard
only), and what happened.
:::

[Email us about a problem](mailto:hammel@uic.edu?subject=PEN%20site%20issue&body=Page%3A%20%0ABrowser%20or%20assistive%20technology%3A%20%0AWhat%20happened%3A%20){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}
